transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, mostly I'm here because I just don't sleep right anymore. I lay there a long time at night trying to drop off. Then I end up waking up from bad dreams, or even just little noises, and... I just can't seem to settle back down after that.
Did these sleep problems start after a specific traumatic or stressful event?
Yes, it did. This has been going on since... well, since the ladder accident. That was about a year and seven months ago now.
During the day, do you ever find yourself having unwanted, upsetting memories or images of the accident popping into your mind?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes... well, if I hear metal scrape, or even just see a ladder leaning up in somebody's yard, the whole thing just jumps right back in my head. It's like I'm right back under there again, just waiting for help.
Do you find yourself going out of your way to avoid things, places, or situations that remind you of the accident?

Yeah, I guess I do. I just... well, I keep finding reasons not to go down to the senior center. And I don't really work around the garage anymore, either. I just stay away from it, especially over near the tools or that spot where I used to keep the ladder. It's just easier not to go near there.
